_doc: Rulebook rows whose change a human reviewed against the router templates. 'approved' rows are not treated as changes; 'pending' rows are listed for review and stay switched off. Row keys are '<section>|<row name, accent-stripped>'.

approved.key: 2|den het ngay x, tinh den hom nay
approved.reason: The public rulebook only adds 'chua giao' to the examples of remaining-count questions (owed, in stock, still to deliver). The router answers period aggregates (revenue, order counts, rankings), not remaining-state questions, so the row's meaning for them is unchanged.

pending.note: Public adds: an order returned after the period, even after today, is still excluded from the placement period's revenue. Checked on the 24 dev shops: 6041 returned orders, 0 of them in v_valid_orders and 0 returned lines in v_valid_lines, so the views exclude a returned order whatever the period. NOT proven as asked: the data has no return-date column, so orders returned after their period cannot be counted. Left switched off until a human decides.
